metadata.title: Isotropy sets of periodic geodesic flows on three dimensional manifolds
metadata.abstract: A classical theorem of Wadsley states that if all geodesics on a Riemannian manifold M are periodic, then they have a common period, and the geodesic flow induces an S^1-action on the unit tangent bundle. Moreover, a conjecture of Berger asserts that this action is free whenever M is simply connected. In this paper, we investigate the Berger conjecture in dimension three by studying the isotropy set of the S^1-action induced by the geodesic flow. Using Morse theory for the energy functional on the free loop space of M, we establish two results in this direction. First, we show that all isotropy groups of the geodesic flow have odd order. Second, we prove that the geodesic flow either acts freely on the unit tangent bundle $T^1M$ or has at least two singular orbit types. This paper serves as preparation for the subsequent paper The Berger conjecture for three-dimensional manifolds, in which the conjecture is proved in dimension three.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究三维流形上所有测地线闭合时，周期测地流圆作用的各向同性群及奇异轨道类型。
techniques: 自由环空间的能量 Morse 理论
analysis.breakthrough: 证明各向同性群阶均为奇数，且圆作用或者自由，或者至少有两类奇异轨道。
analysis.limitations: 本文是三维 Berger 猜想后续证明的准备工作，不能将完整猜想的证明归给本文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
